name: Wintertodt

mechanics.name: Downed Pyromancer
mechanics.description: The pyromancer keeping your brazier lit gets knocked out. While they are down the brazier goes cold and stops giving points.
mechanics.counterplay: Heal them with a bandage straight away. Everything else can wait.

mechanics.name: Brazier Fire
mechanics.description: Braziers burn out and have to be relit, and standing in the wrong place when one goes up costs health.
mechanics.counterplay: Relight it and step back. Warm clothing cuts everything the cold and the fire do to you.

mechanics.name: Cold and Falling Snow
mechanics.description: The cold chips away at you the whole time, snow drops on the braziers, and the Wintertodt itself throws bursts across the arena.
mechanics.counterplay: Wear warm clothing, keep your health up, and move when the ground is marked. None of this is prayable.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED, AND STRUCTURALLY UNUSUAL. THE WINTERTODT IS NOT AN NPC AT ALL. A search of the cache's npc names for 'wintertodt' returns nothing: the boss is scenery, and everything that happens in the fight is the cold, the braziers, the snow and the pyromancers rather than anything an npc does. That is a problem for this plugin specifically, because npcIds is what tells the detection engine it is in a fight (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and the validator requires it to be non-empty. THE WORKAROUND IS TO TRACK THE PYROMANCERS INSTEAD: WINT_WIZARD 7371, WINT_WIZARD_DOWN 7372 and WINT_MASTER_PYROMANCER 7374 are npcs, they are present for the whole fight, and they exist nowhere else in the game, so tracking them is exactly equivalent to being at the Wintertodt. It is a compromise and it is worth naming as one: it means the plugin considers you 'in the fight' from the moment a pyromancer is on screen. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). EVERY MECHANIC HERE DETECTS ON npc-spawn, because there is no boss to play an animation. WINT_WIZARD_DOWN 7372 is a genuinely good trigger, since that npc only exists when a pyromancer has actually been knocked out, so the downed-pyromancer mechanic unlocks at the right moment. The other two are weaker: WINT_FIRE 7373 and WINT_MASTER_PYROMANCER 7374 are present from the start, so those unlock on arrival. The cache names exactly two Wintertodt animations, WINTERTODT_IDLE_B 7322 and WINTERTODT_RESTING 7323, and neither is an attack. THE PREVIEW PINS modelId 42780, taken from struct 3571, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry for this page, at zoom 2500, with shiftY computed from that model's bind pose at that zoom. There is no npc to resolve the model from, so this is the only route to showing the boss at all. THREE MECHANICS IS THE LIMIT OF WHAT THE CACHE SUPPORTS, and this file is closer to a description of the activity than to a mechanic list. The collection log page is titled 'Wintertodt', matching 'name'.
